title: SCCNH Gravel Trial Tech Form
instructions: Teams will inspect items marked "team". Scrutineer will check safety related items.

items.label: Helmet
items.accepts: Snell SA2015 (expires end of 2026), EA2016, SA2020 or SA2025; FIA 8860-2010, 8859-2015, 8860-2018 or 8859-2024 less than 10 years from manufacture; dual FIA/Snell: later expiration applies

items.label: Suit
items.accepts: FIA 8856-2000, 8856-2018 or FIA 1986; SFI 3-2A/5 or 3-4A/5; SFI 3-2A/1 only with approved fire-resistant underwear

items.label: Head and Neck Device
items.accepts: FIA 8858-2002 or 8858-2010, or SFI 38.1 with conformance label less than 5 years old; mounted per manufacturer

items.label: Organization and #
items.accepts: Log book from Rally America, SCCA Pro Rally, CARS, ARA, FIA or NASA Rallysport (other organizations need Chairman approval)

items.label: Logbook deficiency repaired
items.accepts: Deficiencies noted in the log book have been repaired

items.label: Auxiliary Lights
items.accepts: Securely mounted, no higher than the top of the hood, beam toward the front

items.label: Headlights high/low beams
items.accepts: Headlights function properly, high and low beam

items.label: Directionals
items.accepts: Front turn signals work

items.label: Windshield wiper and washer
items.accepts: Wipers and washer work

items.label: Horn
items.accepts: Works

items.label: Hood pins
items.accepts: Hood fixed closed with hood pins accessible from outside; other fasteners inoperative except secondary catch

items.label: Towing eye
items.accepts: Front tow point present and sound

items.label: Tail lights
items.accepts: Taillights function properly

items.label: Brake lights
items.accepts: Brake lights work

items.label: Directionals
items.accepts: Rear turn signals work

items.label: Reverse lights
items.accepts: Work

items.label: License plate lights
items.accepts: Work

items.label: Tow eye
items.accepts: Rear tow point present and sound

items.label: Neat and clean
items.accepts: Car presented neat and clean

items.label: Windshield - safety glass
items.accepts: Laminated safety-glass windshield, no damage obstructing vision

items.label: Windows in place
items.accepts: All windows in place

items.label: Rear view mirror
items.accepts: Present and secure

items.label: Driver/Co-driver names
items.accepts: Driver and co-driver names displayed on the car

items.label: Event sponsor
items.accepts: Event decals placed as instructed at tech

items.label: Numbers and class
items.accepts: Car numbers min. 8 in tall, 1.25 in brush width, supplied by the entrant (class marking N/R)

items.label: Mud flaps-rear and driven wheels
items.accepts: Mud flaps behind rear and driven wheels

items.label: Other Org decals cover'd/remov'd
items.accepts: Rally school decals other than Team O'Neil (e.g. The Firm, DirtFish) and any SCCA decals removed or covered

items.label: Roll cage legality
items.accepts: Six-point mounting, A-pillar supports, min. two door bars per side, diagonals to each top corner of the main hoop, min. tubing 1.5" x 0.095" (regardless of log book)

items.label: FIA or SFI roll cage padding
items.accepts: SFI 45.1 or FIA 8857-2001 Type A on any bar the helmet can reach, including roofline bars and bars forward of the main hoop

items.label: Floor pan and firewall, no holes
items.accepts: No holes in floor pan or firewall

items.label: Door structure or impact panel
items.accepts: Door structure intact or impact panel fitted; no exposed sharp edges

items.label: Restraints , SFI/ FIA-5 yrs
items.accepts: 5-, 6- or 7-point harness for driver and co-driver, FIA 8853/98 or 8853/2016 or SFI 16.1/16.5, single-latch release; not past expiration and not older than 5 years from manufacture

items.label: Restraints angles/anchors/pins
items.accepts: Harness angles, anchors and hardware installed per manufacturer's instructions

items.label: Seats securely fastened
items.accepts: FIA 8855-1999 or 8862-2009 (or racing seat accepted by Chief Scrutineer); no hinged-back or OEM seats; firmly mounted per manufacturer

items.label: Battery, battery box, + post cov'd
items.accepts: Battery secure, boxed if relocated, positive post covered

items.label: Fuel tank or fuel cell
items.accepts: Tank or cell secure, no leaks

items.label: Fuel lines, pump
items.accepts: Lines and pump secure, no leaks

items.label: Fuel cell bulkhead
items.accepts: Fuel tank/cell sealed from the cockpit

items.label: Fire Extinguisher: 10B:C min
items.accepts: 1 x 10 B:C min. (or 2 x 5 B:C) inside the cockpit, one within reach of a seated crew member; metal strap and metal bracket; fill gauge visible

items.label: 3 DOT triangles, 1 w/in reach
items.accepts: 3 emergency triangles, one within reach of a seated crew member

items.label: First Aid kit
items.accepts: Not required by the rules (N/R); if carried, secure

items.label: Tow rope/strap
items.accepts: Appropriate tow strap in the car

items.label: Environmental spill kit
items.accepts: Not required by the rules (N/R); if carried, secure

items.label: Exhaust secure
items.accepts: Exhaust securely mounted, no leaks

items.label: 105 dbA max @ 18" and 45 deg
items.accepts: 105 dBA max at 18 in from the tail pipe, 45 degrees, 2500 rpm (including anti-lag pops)

items.label: Restrictor 30 / 32 / 34 / 36 mm
items.accepts: 4WD forced induction: inlet max. 36 mm, min. 3 mm wide, within 50 mm of the compressor wheel, all air through the restrictor

items.label: Tires and wheels, incl spare
items.accepts: Appropriate tires; DOT studded tires only at winter events; no homemade studs, bolts or chains

items.label: Brakes
items.accepts: Firm pedal, no leaks

items.label: Parking brake
items.accepts: Holds the car

items.label: Wheel bearings, steering linkage
items.accepts: No excessive play

items.label: Shocks/suspension
items.accepts: Secure, no leaks or damage

items.label: Brake hoses/cables
items.accepts: No leaks, chafing or damage

items.label: Suspension arms/mounting points
items.accepts: No cracks or damage
